setup_render_out: create output directory structure with overlaid, side, and merged subfolders for rendering mocap visualization results
setup_input: detect input type and initialize video capture, image list, or bbox data from args.input_path
extract_mesh_from_output: extract vertices and faces from hand or body mocap prediction output dictionaries into a mesh list
load_info_from_json: load image path and body and hand bounding box lists from a JSON annotation file
save_pred_to_pkl: save mocap prediction results including SMPL params and optionally mesh data to a pickle file
